name: Fire Safety Essentials
summary:
A fire extinguisher only helps if you know how to use it, which one to pick, and when to put it down and leave. Fire Safety Essentials teaches all three in a VR experience set in an industrial warehouse.

You start with a small fire on a stack of wood panels and learn the PASS method hands-on: pull the pin, aim at the base of the fire, squeeze the trigger and sweep from side to side, standing 6–8 feet back behind a marked line.
